يمتطين (form VIII)
# يَمْتَطِينَ (yamtaṭīna) /jam.ta.tˤiː.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
# يُمْتَطَيْنَ (yumtaṭayna) /jum.ta.tˤaj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
